workflow.name: K-U-Th Concentration Estimation via PAD Spectral Decomposition
workflow.description: Estimates K (%), U (ppm), Th (ppm) for each input .spc file using three PAD reference spectra and a 3x3 PAD composition matrix. Energy-calibrated with a quadratic Geomon fit. Features are ROI sums around key gamma lines. Concentrations are recovered via least-squares spectral unmixing.

--spectra.description: Path to folder containing input .spc spectra files

--pad-dir.description: Path to folder containing PAD_K_A.spc, PAD_U_A.spc, PAD_Th_A.spc

--out.description: Output CSV file path (full path including filename)

--roi-half-width-kev.description: Half-width in keV of each ROI window centred on a reference gamma line

--normalize-live-time.description: If set, normalises all spectra (PAD and input) to counts-per-second using live time from SPC header

energy_calibration.description: Fit E(ch) = c0 + c1*ch + c2*ch^2 using known anchor pairs. Validated Geomon anchors.

pad_reference_spectra.description: Three PAD reference spectra used as spectral end-members for unmixing

PAD_K_A.description: High-potassium PAD reference. Dominant K-40 peak at 1460.8 keV.

PAD_U_A.description: High-uranium PAD reference. Strong Bi-214 lines at 609.3 and 1764.5 keV.

PAD_Th_A.description: High-thorium PAD reference. Strong Tl-208 line at 2614.5 keV.

spc_format.lines_3_to_1026: Counts per channel (1024 channels total, one value per line)
spc_format.last_line: Footer metadata string (e.g. '11.4 0 3 0') - not used in processing

pad_composition_matrix.description: Hard-coded 3x3 matrix C_PAD where c = C_PAD @ w gives element concentrations from PAD weights. Rows = [K, U, Th], Columns = [PAD_K_A, PAD_U_A, PAD_Th_A]

spectral_unmixing.description: Solves y_feats = M_ref @ w using numpy.linalg.lstsq, then clips w to >= 0.

columns.name: latitude
columns.description: Latitude from .spc trailing metadata (blank if missing)

columns.name: longitude
columns.description: Longitude from .spc trailing metadata (blank if missing)

columns.name: elevation
columns.description: Elevation from .spc trailing metadata (blank if missing)

columns.name: U_from_PADK
columns.description: U ppm contribution from PAD_K_A (1.38 * w_PADK)

columns.name: U_from_PADU
columns.description: U ppm contribution from PAD_U_A (40.87 * w_PADU)

columns.name: U_from_PADTh
columns.description: U ppm contribution from PAD_Th_A (1.90 * w_PADTh)

columns.name: Th_from_PADK
columns.description: Th ppm contribution from PAD_K_A (2.54 * w_PADK)

columns.name: Th_from_PADU
columns.description: Th ppm contribution from PAD_U_A (4.42 * w_PADU)

columns.name: Th_from_PADTh
columns.description: Th ppm contribution from PAD_Th_A (111.59 * w_PADTh)

steps.name: Load PAD Reference Spectra
steps.output: pad_k_counts, pad_u_counts, pad_th_counts [1024 each] + live times

steps.name: Build PAD Feature Matrix M_ref
steps.input: Three PAD counts arrays + energy_keV + roi_half_width_kev

sub_steps.name: Write CSV Row + Log to Console
sub_steps.output: One row appended to output CSV; [OK] or [ERR] printed to stdout

error_handling.FileNotFoundError: Raised if a PAD file does not exist at the given path
error_handling.RuntimeError_spc_too_short: Raised if a .spc file has fewer than header_lines + n_channels (1026) lines
error_handling.per_file_exception: Caught per file in try/except; logs [ERR] filename -> error message; processing continues
error_handling.empty_spectra_folder: Logs [WARN] and returns cleanly without writing CSV

notes.live_time_units: SPC header line 1 stores live time in microseconds. Conversion to seconds: live_us * 1e-6.
notes.clock_time_unused: SPC header line 2 (clock time) is parsed but not used in any calculation.
notes.nnls_approximation: numpy.linalg.lstsq followed by max(w,0) is a NNLS approximation. For strict NNLS use scipy.optimize.nnls instead.
notes.pad_column_order: Columns in M_ref and C_PAD must always be in the fixed order [PAD_K_A, PAD_U_A, PAD_Th_A].
notes.recalibration: Anchor channel values are detector-specific. Recalibrate ANCHORS_CH if using a different instrument.
notes.embedded_pad_variant: PAD files can be embedded as multiline string constants inside the script, removing the --pad-dir file dependency. See companion DeepSeek embedding prompt.
